newsitem.title: USA: Kimco Realty likely to split up - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kimco Realty likely to split up - WSJ.

text.p: Shopping center owner Kimco Realty Corp plans to split itself in hopes of providing investors with higher returns, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Wednesday's electronic edition, the paper said Kimco Chairman Milton Cooper plans to break Kimco into two real estate investment trusts.

The paper cites executives close to Kimco who say one of the new REITs would consist of short-term leases and speculative acquisitions that offer investors potential high growth rates, while the other would consist of long-term leases providing steady, predictable income.
Cooper is credited with launching the REIT boom when Kimco went public in 1991, the paper said.
